Profit Before Tax derived as Net Profit plus Income Tax; Gross Profit as Revenue minus Cost of Sales. Cross checked: Profit Before Tax minus Income Tax equals Net Profit and Revenue minus Cost of Sales equals Gross Profit. | CRON 20260929_003746: Profit Before Tax added, 35,375,000,000 for FY2025 and 43,666,000,000 for FY2024, and Net Profit corrected to the printed Profit After Tax. Source: Kenya Power audited results for the year ended 30 June 2025, condensed income statement, KShs million: Revenue 219,285, Cost of sales 144,664, Gross Margin 74,621, Other income 7,267, Operating costs 42,421, Operating Profit 39,467, Interest income 625, Finance costs 4,717, Profit Before Tax 35,375, Income tax expense 10,908, Profit After Tax 24,467, Other comprehensive income 1,105, Total comprehensive income 23,362, basic and diluted earnings per share 12.54. The file previously carried 23,362,023,000 as Net Profit for FY2025 and 30,471,321,000 for FY2024, which are the printed total comprehensive income lines rather than profit after tax. Profit Before Tax less Income Tax now equals Net Profit on both periods. FY2023 and FY2022 Profit Before Tax are left empty because the announcement carries only the two comparative columns.
